verdict.rationale: Two distribution routes are documented. The set was accepted into Claude Code's official marketplace and installs with `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` as a managed, read-only bundle that updates when the author ships. Alternatively, an installer writes editable skill files into your repo, which you can commit and pull updates for on demand with `npx skills update`, and it works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. Missing for 10: no explicit team or org rollout guidance (e.g. version pinning or a shared-repo setup for a whole team), and no independent or hands-on confirmation that either install route works.
